title: Tulsa, OK — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Tulsa, OK: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Tulsa is a city in OK with a population of 411,401. Oil capital with Art Deco architecture, a $10K remote worker incentive, and cheap living. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees.
